lines.en: Can you carry this box for me?
Sure, Mom. Is it heavy?
Yes. I pulled it here this morning.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 여기까지 끌고 왔어요.

lines.en: Please don't pull heavy boxes. I will carry them.
lines.ko: 무거운 상자는 끌지 마세요. 제가 나를게요.

lines.en: Thank you. Put it by the door, please.
Okay. Where do I put the small one?
Bring it to the kitchen. Hold it with two hands.
Okay. Don't touch that box. It is dirty.
lines.ko: 네. 그 상자는 만지지 마세요. 더러워요.

lines.en: Will you push the table back later?
Yes, I will. Let's pick up the last one.
Grandma, can you catch this ball?
lines.ko: 할머니, 이 공 잡을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes! Throw it to me. I will catch it.
Here it comes! Did you catch it?
Yes! I'm holding it now. Good throw!
lines.ko: 네! 지금 잡고 있어요. 잘 던졌어요!

lines.en: Please throw it high, Grandma! I can catch it.
lines.ko: 할머니, 높이 던져 주세요! 제가 잡을 수 있어요.

lines.en: Okay. Yesterday I threw it too far.
I will catch it this time!
Good catch! Now bring it here and put it down.
lines.ko: 잘 잡았어요! 이제 이리 가져와서 내려놓아요.

lines.en: Will you play with me again tomorrow?
lines.ko: 내일 또 저랑 놀아 줄 거예요?

lines.en: Yes, I will. Let's go home now.
